conditions: The assertion is about declarations in the pinned 1.9 RFC.
limitations: Parameterized-alias bounds, variance and visibility have additional rules. Later support for nested aliases requires its own edition-specific evidence.

triggers: Recheck any publisher correction, source integrity change, or contrary evidence about the pinned RFC edition.

statement: The Kotlin/Core 1.9 RFC describes a type alias as an alternative name for a specified simple or parameterized type. This edition permits only top-level type aliases and forbids using the alias itself in its defining right-hand side.
